test_title: PYST 42: SSC MTS 2024 - General Awareness (Held On: 30 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following is NOT considered as a Fundamental Duty?

options.text: To value and preserve the rich heritage of our composite culture
To uphold and protect the sovereignty, unity and integrity of India
To develop the scientific temper, humanism and the spirit of inquiry and reform

solution:
The Correct answer is __**To uphold and protect secularism**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The concept of **Fundamental Duties** was introduced through the **42nd Amendment Act** of the Indian Constitution in **1976**.
 
• Fundamental Duties are enumerated under **Article 51A** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The Fundamental Duties primarily focus on the promotion of a sense of **patriotism** and strengthening the spirit of **unity and integrity** within the nation.
 
• While the duty to uphold and protect the **sovereignty, unity, and integrity of India** is explicitly mentioned in the Fundamental Duties, protecting secularism is not directly specified as a Fundamental Duty.
 
• Secularism is a part of the **Preamble** and is considered a core principle of the Indian Constitution but does not appear in the list of Fundamental Duties under **Article 51A**.
 
• India is a **secular state**, meaning that the government treats all religions equally, but ensuring secularism is a responsibility of the state rather than being categorized as a Fundamental Duty for citizens.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **To value and preserve the rich heritage of our composite culture**__

 __
 
• This duty emphasizes the importance of protecting and preserving India’s **historical monuments, traditions, and diverse cultural heritage.**
 
• It is meant to foster respect for the **rich diversity** of India's composite culture.
 
 
 
• **To uphold and protect the sovereignty, unity, and integrity of India**__
 __
 
• This duty involves ensuring the **nation's security** and standing against any threats that aim to divide the country.
 
• It is considered crucial for maintaining **national stability** and harmony.
 
 
 
• **To develop the scientific temper, humanism, and the spirit of inquiry and reform**__
 
 
• This duty encourages citizens to adopt a rational and **scientific mindset**.
 
• It promotes the spirit of **innovation**, reform, and critical thinking to improve societal standards.
 
• The goal is to eliminate superstition and foster **progressive values**.
